dxf_upload_region_rule: exact canonical filename stem equals server region id
online_rendering: persistent fiber cache + cache-first viewport + instant layer hide/show restore
map_labels: device IDs/pole numbers/address text hidden; details on selection only
line_color_policy: preserve CAD display_color/true_color; fallback distinguishes fiber/coax/cell-boundary/connection lines
device_rendering: dedupe same-kind nearby device points by spatial key; filter text/info payloads before device rendering
zoom_rendering: zoom_changed only toggles in-memory overlay visibility; no API reload
cache_policy: render stale/valid cache immediately; refresh stale bbox in background; replace only after successful fetch/save; then rerender
upload_session_policy: no fixed Windows client timeout; heartbeat every 15s; pause local idle guard during upload
fiber_cache_policy: never discard visible old fiber cache before complete new fiber collection is verified and saved
coax_device_policy: preserve explicit legacy device POINTs and keep device symbols above cables
device_filter_policy: TEXT/MTEXT/ATTRIB/ID/address/info entities are never rendered as devices
fiber_device_policy: fiber equipment CLOSURE/TERMINAL/CENTER/FOSC/FDF is assigned to FIBER at upload; viewer relies on group_id=FIBER at L3 without code-based group override
server_upload_proxy_policy: apply server-tools/apply_long_upload_timeout_v1.sh to set nginx request/proxy timeouts to 86400s
upload_progress_policy: exact transmitted bytes / total JSON bytes percentage; after 100%, show server DB save/validation phase
fiber_geometry_policy: preserve every CAD line/polyline/polygon primitive; multipart entities are split into independent server-compatible LineString objects
annotation_policy: -Anno/ANNO registration and annotation objects are excluded from upload and rendering for fiber/coax
amplifier_direction_policy: coax polyline last point touching amplifier = input; arrow points into amplifier; amplifier orientation is opposite input / signal-output direction; ambiguous input shows no arrow
directional_device_policy: AMP/TAP/splitter: coax polyline last point touching device = input; arrow on input cable only; device orientation follows signal output direction
splitter_symbol_policy: CN_C_Passive 2SP-B/3SP-B and 2/3-way/2/3-branch/DC use circular splitter symbol; label 2/3/DC; PI only uses rectangular centered I; live CAD block signature overrides legacy stored symbol kind
symbol_mapping_policy: actual CMB CAD layer/block codes are authoritative for all device symbols; legacy stored symbol_kind is fallback only
l3_coax_policy: L3 hides only COAX cable handles explicitly listed in TAP _cmb_connections; trunk cables remain; TAP input arrows hidden at L3
distance_measurement_policy: Distance button starts a new multi-point section; map clicks add points; Esc finalizes current total; right-click finished line offers delete; Distance Delete clears all measurements
toolbar_layout_policy: buttons remain fixed in non-shrinking group; status text uses only remaining width and ellipsizes without moving controls
connector_view_policy: CN_C_CONNECTOR and CONNECTOR* are excluded from Windows viewer rendering; server data remains unchanged
device_zoom_scale_policy: L1=1.65x, L2=1.35x, L3=1.12x, L4+=0.90x; devices redraw from memory on zoom
upload_geometry_policy: server accepts Point/LineString only; multipart CAD primitives are uploaded as separate LineString objects with unique part object_id while original source_handle is preserved
upload_handle_policy: multipart LineString parts receive unique source_handle suffixes; original CAD handle is preserved in _cmb_original_handle
fiber_view_policy: keep visible old fiber cache until complete replacement is verified; multipart-safe cache keys; diagnostics show server/received/unique/cache/line/render counts
cable_selection_policy: selected fiber/coax/conduit cable is raised above devices, shown thicker with contrasting highlight color, and previous selection restores original style
full_upload_policy: full upload includes FIBER/COAX/CONDUIT only; POLE/USER/SYMBOL require selected/manual upload
lod_policy: L5 coax cell boundary; L4 coax cell number labels; L3 fiber connected devices plus existing detailed coax devices
default_layer_policy: online viewer starts with FIBER and COAX enabled; POLE and CONDUIT remain disabled; LOD controls actual visibility
fiber_device_render_policy: persist FIBER point-device feature memory and redraw it after zoom/LOD device clear operations
extraction_viewer_policy: render original CAD primitives for equipment; do not replace INSERT/POINT devices with simplified online symbols
online_fiber_symbol_policy: NETOFD/NETFDF outlined labeled rectangle; RN-* small hollow triangle; Terminal/OIM separate icon; SPL-*/FO_VCONN Closure; cell number red 2x; ONU 1.2x
closure_symbol_policy: 24x15 light-blue enclosure; 3 small circular ports on each short side (6 total); no tails; port geometry rotates with device
fiber_direction_policy: show V arrow toward last coordinate of each FIBER cable part
rn_symbol_policy: RN-8W/RN-4W hollow triangle labeled 8/4 without generic direction line
extraction_default_hidden_policy: CN_*_ID, jibun, address, info and annotation/text layers start disabled and are excluded from initial render
map_base_mode_policy: Kakao ROADMAP/HYBRID toggle; button always shows destination mode (위성지도/일반지도) without reloading network overlays
fiber_arrow_policy: filled triangular FIBER input arrowhead; much larger zoom-scaled L1=1.70x/L2=1.45x/L3=1.20x/L4+=1.00x
drawing_force_reload_policy: bypass valid drawing cache, reparse source DXF, atomically replace cache only after successful rebuild
roadview_policy: 로드뷰 button opens nearest Kakao Roadview within 100m of current map center; button changes to 지도보기; base-map toggle disabled while Roadview is active
cable_device_connection_policy: logical/topology connection remains device-center based; rendered cable endpoint snaps to symbol boundary plus 3px inward overlap beneath opaque symbol to prevent visible gaps
fiber_terminal_policy: square terminal; no common direction line; pink L2/L3 centered inside and rotated with device
fiber_net_policy: NETOFD/NETFDF centered inside device at compact text size, rotated with device; no common direction line
fiber_rn_policy: no triangle; render only 4RN/8RN as horizontal label above device/closure position for readability
